layout_dets.text: Synopsis: A new duplex stainless steel containing

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: was developed. The tube

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of the duplex stainless steel was manufactured by a powder metallurgical process which was

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: introduced to avoid the sigma-emblittlement of the billet. The developed steel was

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: superior to a conventional 25%Cr duplex stainless steel and equalto super-ferritic or

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: super-austenitic stainless steels on the resistance to pitting and crevice corrosion in hot

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: seawater environments. Further, the corrosion resistance of the weldment was investigated

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and the effect of the welding procedure was clarified. Consequently, the developed steel

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: was considered to be suitable for hot seawater applications such as heat exchanger tube.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Key words: duplex stainless steel, super-stainless steel, powder metallurgy, pitting

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: corrosion, crevice corrosion, seawater, heat exchanger tube

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 1. Introduction

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Ferritic-austenitic duplex stainless steels(SSs) have been used as the tubular

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: products in chemical industries, for example, heat exchanger tubes and various pipings [1]-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: [3]. They are superior to ferritic SSs in toughness and weldability, and to austenitic SSs

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: in stress corrosion cracking resistance. Duplex SSs have another advantage over austenitic

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: SSs in cost saving, because they need less Ni content than austenitic SSs when their

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: contents of Cr and Mo are increased for improving the corrosion resistance. For this

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: reason, duplex SSs of high Cr and Mo contents have been applied to severely corrosive

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: environments as a substitute for expensive austenitic SSs.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Recently, ferritic and austenitic SSs which are called 'super-SSs' have been

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: developed for the application in the highly corrosive environments containing chloride ion

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: such as seawater [4]-[8]. They contain more Cr, Mo (and N for super-austenitic SSs) as

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: alloying elements than conventional SSs to improve the corrosion resistance. On the other

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: hand the commercial duplex SSs, in general, contain less Cr and Mo than the super-SSs, and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: do not always have enough corrosion resistance on the hot seawater application [3]. It is

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: thought to be worthwhile to develop a super-duplex SS which contains high Cr and Mo and has

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the corrosion resistance equal to super-ferritic and austenitic SSs[9]. As for duplex SSs,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: however, the increase in the Cr and Mo contents for improving the corrosion resistance

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: accelerates the sigma phase precipitation to bring the embrittlement of the billet on tube

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: making process. This is the reason why the super-duplex SS has been difficult to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: manufacture by the conventional process.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In this report a new duplex SS containing 28%Cr and 3.8%Mo is introduced which has

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: been developed by applying a powder metallurgical method by which the sigma-embrittlement

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of the billet can be avoided.The corrosion resistance of the developed steel including

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: its weldment is also presented on the application in hot seawater environment.

layout_dets.text: 2. Development of 28%Cr duplex stainless steel

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2-1. Background

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The addition of Cr and Mo is necessary to improve the resistance to the localized

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: corrosion by chloride attack. When a index, which is called pitting index(P. I.) and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: calculated by (%Cr) + 3(%Mo) + 10(%N), is introduced to estimate the resistance to pitting

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: corrosion of SSs, some typical super-SSs proves to have the P. I. value over 40 [5],[10].

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: On the other hand the conventional duplex SS containing 25%Cr and 3%Mo only have the P. I.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: value around 36. Therefore a super-duplex SS with the corrosion resistance equal to super-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ferritic and austenitic SSs is necessary to contain much higher contents of Cr and Mo.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: However the duplex SS tube of higher Cr and Mo contents cannot be easily manufactured by

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the usual process because the sigma-emblittlement of the billet becomes a serious

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: problem.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: To avoid the sigma-emblittlement problem a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: powder metallurgical(P/M) technique was

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: introduced to the tube manufacturing process.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In the P/M process the billet consists of the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: powder which is packed in a steel capsule and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: consequently no sigma-emblittlement occurs.

layout_dets.text: 2-3. Tube manufacturing

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The seamless tube of the 28%Cr duplex SS with the optimum chemical composition was

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: manufactured through the P/M process shown in Fig. 6 [14]. The duplex SS powder was atom-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ized by nitrogen gas and packed into a mild steel capsule. The powder billet was processed

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: by cold isostatic pressing(CIP) and hot extruded to the tube. The tube was acid pickled in

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: order to remove the capsule and then heat treated at 1373K(1100°C) followed by water

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: quenching.

layout_dets.text: 4. Conclusions

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Fig.13 Pitting potential of tube-to-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 1) A super-duplex stainless steel which was composed of 27.5%Cr-7%Ni-3.8%Mo-0.3%N was

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: developed from the investigation of the weldment performance. The seamless tube of the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: alloy was successfully manufactured by the powder metallurgical process.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2) The corrosion resistance of the 28%Cr duplex SS in hot seawater environments was

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: superior to the conventional 25%Cr duplex SS and almost equal to those of super-ferritic

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and super-austenitic stainless steels.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 3) The 25%Cr duplex SS was found to be applicable as the tube sheet material matching with

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the 28%Cr duplex SS tube from the viewpoint of the pitting corrosion resistance of the seal

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: weldment.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 4) The developed alloy was concluded to be suitable for the application in the highly

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: corrosive environments such as hot seawater.
